label: VERIFIED
extraction: Agent Eval Harness (Siddharth-1001): Open-source evaluation framework for agentic systems - not just LLM outputs but full agent behavior. 20 stars, MIT. Lightweight, trace/measure/compare agents in minutes, no vendor lock-in, all data local. Addresses: hallucinated tool arguments (fabricated plausible-but-wrong params), silent latency regressions (model update doubles response time), cost creep (token usage 3x after prompt change), tool failures (success rate 95% to 60% across deployments). Provides structured traces, automated metrics, side-by-side comparisons. Python 3.12+, pyproject.toml, uv.lock.
